title: Make quickRollback persistence atomic with restore result
problem: quickRollback may persist rollback/checkpoint state even when restore fails, causing state drift from actual workspace outcome.
implementation_outline: Move checkpoint/rollback state persistence behind restore success condition.
On restore failure, keep prior persisted state and surface structured failure reason.
Retain backward-compatible response shape while correcting semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Failed restore never writes misleading success-state checkpoint.
Successful restore persists expected state once.
Error response includes actionable failure reason for caller/UI.
